name: Richard Ojeda II
page_title: Richard Ojeda II's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (NC) - District 9

positions.question: Do you generally support pro-choice or pro-life legislation?

evidence.text: "I am Pro Life! I do not agree with the recent decision made by our governor vetoing the bill to ban abortions at the 20 week mark."
“I'm not for abortion but don’t think that a woman who is raped should have to carry the seed if she chooses not to. I also think that incest and the life of the mother matters."

positions.question: In order to balance the budget, do you support an income tax increase on any tax bracket?

evidence.text: "The true handouts today are not $650 a month to the poor! They are the tax breaks and giveaways to those who are the wealthiest in this country who have more money then they could spend in a lifetime."
"We live in one of the wealthiest nations in the world and yet we prioritize millionaire's tax cuts over average working families"
"Working families need a lot more from us as public servants. One thing they don't need? Tax breaks for our nations most wealthy."

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?
positions.original_question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support entitlement programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: " I support Medicare for all!"
"Medicare for ALL. No more gold packages, sweetened deals or easier access for members of Congress."

"We cannot allow these greedy politicians to continue to stick their hands in the cookie jar of Social Security, take from our elderly, disrespect our veterans, make cuts to Medicare all the while sitting in their offices collecting corporate checks that keep them elected."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?
positions.original_question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations and unions?

evidence.text: "I won't take a single check from a corporate PAC because I refuse to be bought."
"Overturn Citizens United."

"What does campaign finance reform look like? It starts with a convention for a constitutional amendment to overturn Citizens United, the max donation allowed being $250 and donor vouchers so that working families can be just as influential in elections as millionaires."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "We have infrastructure issues and a military machine that needs rebuilt."

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?
positions.original_question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth?

evidence.text: "Ojeda will fight to increase infrastructure jobs that will not only boost our economy but provide better roads, bridges etc to the country."
"We have infrastructure issues and a military machine that needs rebuilt."

positions.question: Do you support lowering corporate taxes as a means of promoting economic growth?

evidence.text: "Because of Paul Ryan’s gutless inability to stand up to this president, thousands of Americans are going without a paycheck. Meanwhile he will go and cash in on the billions he gave out in corporate tax cuts."
"It sounds like OK has consistently put corporate welfare ahead of the wellbeing of their children and education system. Time to VOTE THEM OUT."
"Republicans in West Virginia think money is best spent in corporate tax breaks than by investing in our teachers and the future of our children. Show them you disagree."

positions.question: Do you support requiring states to adopt federal education standards?

evidence.text: Despite exhaustive research, Vote Smart was unable to find information about this candidate's position.

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "A Green New Deal and the union jobs that come with it will keep working families from ending up in the unemployment line. It is the ONLY way to both fight climate change and guarantee that we don't leave entire communities behind in the process."

"What does a Green New Deal mean for me? It means not leaving entire communities behind in the process. It means millions of new UNION jobs. It means that any higher energy costs are not put on the backs of our working class people."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?
positions.original_question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation?

evidence.text: "I believe in the 2nd and if I have done nothing wrong and have no mental issues leave my guns alone."

"Nobody is wanting to take home defense capabilities but you don’t need assault rifles and 100 round clips for that. A short barreled shitgun is best. We need stronger background checks to deny mentally ill, ties to hate groups, gang ties and violent histories access."

positions.question: Do you support repealing the 2010 Affordable Care Act ("Obamacare")?

evidence.text: "The Affordable Care Act, as it stands, is insufficient. Today, national healthcare expenditures are $9,523 per person in the United States. Even more devastating, out-of-pocket spending is $329.8 billion."

positions.question: Do you support the construction of a wall along the Mexican border?

evidence.text: "And you support a racist 14th century wall that can easily be defeated by a shovel or a ladder."

"Let me tell you something. A wall is the easiest thing to defeat. They already tunneled El Chapo out of two different prisons. If you don’t think the drug cartels already know how to tunnel under your wall you’re a damn fool."

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants who are unlawfully present to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship?

evidence.text: "I'm glad to hear him speak about protecting our DREAMERS, offering a pathway to citizenship for immigrants with clean backgrounds and strengthening our border security against illegal drug trafficking."
"We can live in a country where we not only welcome immigrants but embrace them AND we can ensure that border security is a top priority"
